name: Can you paint over popcorn ceilings?

mainEntity.name: Can you paint over popcorn ceilings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is possible to paint over popcorn ceilings. However, painting an existing popcorn ceiling may not completely hide its texture or minor imperfections. For the best aesthetic result, many clients opt to remove the popcorn texture first, a process that can be messy and complex. If painting over, thorough cleaning and a good primer are essential to ensure adhesion and an even finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, popcorn ceilings can be painted, but it might not fully hide the texture. Removing it first often yields a better finish.
